strategy: K8 metals time-of-day (the friend's 'printer' legs, flat size): buy the side the clock favours in Kalshi's 15-minute gold/silver up/down markets, 20 seconds after the window opens
status: PAPER ONLY. Never armed. Kalshi is paused for real money; only the owner can ever place real orders.

rule.plain: Every US weekday, one taker order per leg, flat $10 each, never more than one order per market, no averaging, no exits (hold to the settle 15 minutes later).
legs: 05:30 DOWN gold: the 05:15-05:30 ET market; at 05:15:20 ET buy NO (= 'down') at the ask
05:30 DOWN silver: the 05:15-05:30 ET market; at 05:15:20 ET buy NO at the ask
17:00 UP gold: the 16:45-17:00 ET market; at 16:45:20 ET buy YES (= 'up') at the ask
17:00 UP silver: the 16:45-17:00 ET market; at 16:45:20 ET buy YES at the ask
16:15 DOWN silver: the 16:00-16:15 ET market; at 16:00:20 ET buy NO at the ask
16:15 DOWN gold: the 16:00-16:15 ET market; at 16:00:20 ET buy NO at the ask
rule.entry_time: 20 seconds after the 15-minute window opens (ET, NTP-synced clock); if no fill by 40 s, skip
rule.price_limit: tested as: take the ask 15-30 s after the open, whatever it is (no cap); in paper, send a limit at that ask and skip if not filled by 40 s
rule.size: $10 per leg (whole contracts = floor(10 / price)); no compounding
rule.fee: Kalshi taker fee 0.07 x C x p x (1-p), rounded up to the cent per order
rule.days: US weekdays only; Kalshi lists these markets Monday-Friday

needs: Kalshi PUBLIC market data on the PC: the market ticker of each window (e.g. KXGOLD15M-26NOV190530-30) and its order book / best ask at 20 s after the open (REST GET /markets/{ticker} or the public websocket)
an NTP-synced clock on the PC (the order must go out 15-30 s after 05:15:00, 16:45:00, 16:00:00 ET)
for real money only (owner's decision, never Claude): the owner's own Kalshi API key on the PC

nothing else is required for the clock legs; optional logging: NinjaTrader 1-minute bars of COMEX gold (GC front month) and silver (SI front month) 04:45-05:45 and 16:15-17:15 ET, to watch whether the drift is still there
unproven: the windows come from the friend's own posts; he probably found them in these same months, so the clean test is forward paper trading from 2026-11-19 (kill rule: stop if the first 60 paper bets win under 55%)
why it happens is not proven: we cannot read Pyth's tick history (it now needs an API key); 05:30 follows the London clock (gold auction at 10:30 London), 16:00 / 17:00 are CME session times
Kalshi already removed the metals windows inside the CME break on 2026-10-01; it or Pyth can change the market list or the index any day and the edge would vanish at once
the friend's bot and copycats buy the same seconds: if market makers start pricing the clock, entry prices rise from ~0.52 toward the win rate (~0.70) and the edge is gone; watch the paid price
losing streaks: test worst streak 8 bets; gold and silver usually lose on the same day
the newest days were the worst: 11/16 evening + all 6 legs on 11/17 lost (8 in a row, -$92 that day at $15); one bad day cannot tell bad luck from the start of the end, which is why paper comes first
the 16:15 legs cost more in November (0.59) and lost money that month: drop them first if paper disappoints
